runs.text: The document does not report a specific capacity in mAh/g for the strained V2O5 films. The text says that galvanostatic charge-discharge curves were obtained for the unstrained and strained states of the surface V2O5 coating,
but the charge-discharge results are only referred to (in the Supporting Information, which is not part of this document), and no capacity values appear in the main text or figures.
